text_en: Be imitators of me, as I am of Christ.
text_cn: 你们该效法我，如我效法了基督一样。

text_en: I commend you because you remember me in everything and maintain the traditions just as I handed them on to you.
text_cn: 我称赞你们在一切事上记念我，并照我所传授给你们的，持守那些传授。

text_en: But I want you to understand that Christ is the head of every man, and the husband is the head of his wife, and God is the head of Christ.
text_cn: 但我愿意你们知道：男人的头是基督，而女人的头是男人，基督的头却是天主。

text_en: Any man who prays or prophesies with something on his head disgraces his head,
text_cn: 凡男人祈祷或说先知话，若蒙着头，就是羞辱自己的头；

text_en: but any woman who prays or prophesies with her head unveiled disgraces her head—it is one and the same thing as having her head shaved.
text_cn: 但凡女人祈祷或说先知话，若不蒙头，就是羞辱自己的头，因为她跟那剃了头发的完全一样。

text_en: For if a woman will not veil herself, then she should cut off her hair; but if it is disgraceful for a woman to have her hair cut off or to be shaved, she should wear a veil.
text_cn: 女人若不蒙头，就让她剪发吧！但若剪发或剃头为女人算是耻辱，她就该蒙头！

text_en: For a man ought not to have his head veiled, since he is the image and reflection of God; but woman is the reflection of man.
text_cn: 男人当然不该蒙头，因为他是天主的肖像和光荣，而女人却是男人的光荣：

text_en: Indeed, man was not made from woman, but woman from man.
text_cn: 原来不是男人出于女人，而是女人出于男人；

text_en: Neither was man created for the sake of woman, but woman for the sake of man.
text_cn: 而且男人不是为女人造的，女人乃是为男人造的。

text_en: For this reason a woman ought to have a symbol of authority on her head, because of the angels.
text_cn: 为此，女人为了天使的缘故，在头上应该有属于权下的表记。

text_en: Nevertheless, in the Lord woman is not independent of man or man independent of woman.
text_cn: 然而在主内，女不可无男，男也不可无女，

text_en: For just as woman came from man, so man comes through woman; but all things come from God.
text_cn: 因为就如女人是出于男人，同样男人也是藉女人而生；但一切都出于天主。

text_en: Judge for yourselves: is it proper for a woman to pray to God with her head unveiled?
text_cn: 你们自己评断吧！女人不蒙头向天主祈祷相宜吗？

text_en: Does not nature itself teach you that if a man wears long hair, it is degrading to him,
text_cn: 不是本性也教训你们：男人若蓄发，为他就是羞辱；

text_en: but if a woman has long hair, it is her glory? For her hair is given to her for a covering.
text_cn: 但是女人若蓄发，为她倒是光荣吗？因为头发是给她当作首帕的。

text_en: But if anyone is disposed to be contentious—we have no such custom, nor do the churches of God.
text_cn: 若有人想强辩，那么他该知道：我们没有这样的风俗，天主的各教会也没有。

text_en: Now in the following instructions I do not commend you, because when you come together it is not for the better but for the worse.
text_cn: 我要嘱咐你们，并不称赞你们，因为你们聚会不是为得益，而是为受害。

text_en: For, to begin with, when you come together as a church, I hear that there are divisions among you; and to some extent I believe it.
text_cn: 首先，我听说你们聚会时，你们中间有分裂的事，我也有几分相信，

text_en: Indeed, there have to be factions among you, for only so will it become clear who among you are genuine.
text_cn: 因为在你们中间原免不了分党分派的事，好叫那些经得起考验的人，在你们中显出来。

text_en: When you come together, it is not really to eat the Lord’s supper.
text_cn: 你们聚集在一处，并不是为吃主的晚餐，

text_en: For when the time comes to eat, each of you goes ahead with your own supper, and one goes hungry and another becomes drunk.
text_cn: 因为你们吃的时候，各人先吃自己的晚餐，甚至有的饥饿，有的却醉饱。

text_en: What! Do you not have homes to eat and drink in? Or do you show contempt for the church of God and humiliate those who have nothing? What should I say to you? Should I commend you? In this matter I do not commend you!
text_cn: 难道你们没有家可以吃喝吗？或是你们想轻视天主的教会，叫那些没有的人羞惭吗？我可给你们说什么？要我称赞你们吗？在这事上，我决不称赞。

text_en: For I received from the Lord what I also handed on to you, that the Lord Jesus on the night when he was betrayed took a loaf of bread,
text_cn: 这是我从主所领受的，我也传授给你们了：主耶稣在他被交付的那一夜，拿起饼来，

text_en: and when he had given thanks, he broke it and said, “This is my body that is for you. Do this in remembrance of me. ”
text_cn: 祝谢了，擘开说：“这是我的身体、为你们而舍的，你们应这样行，为记念我。”

text_en: In the same way he took the cup also, after supper, saying, “This cup is the new covenant in my blood. Do this, as often as you drink it, in remembrance of me. ”
text_cn: 晚餐后，又同样拿起杯来说：“这杯是用我的血所立的新约，你们每次喝，应这样行，为记念我。”

text_en: For as often as you eat this bread and drink the cup, you proclaim the Lord’s death until he comes.
text_cn: 的确，直到主再来，你们每次吃这饼，喝这杯，你们就是宣告主的死亡。

text_en: Whoever, therefore, eats the bread or drinks the cup of the Lord in an unworthy manner will be answerable for the body and blood of the Lord.
text_cn: 为此，无论谁，若不相称地吃主的饼，或喝主的杯，就是干犯主体和主血的罪人。

text_en: Examine yourselves, and only then eat of the bread and drink of the cup.
text_cn: 所以人应省察自己，然后才可以吃这饼，喝这杯。

text_en: For all who eat and drink without discerning the body, eat and drink judgment against themselves.
text_cn: 因为那吃喝的人，若不分辨主的身体，就是吃喝自己的罪案。

text_en: For this reason many of you are weak and ill, and some have died.
text_cn: 为此，在你们中有许多有病和软弱的人，死的也不少。

text_en: But if we judged ourselves, we would not be judged.
text_cn: 但是，若我们先省察自己，我们就不至于受罚了。

text_en: But when we are judged by the Lord, we are disciplined so that we may not be condemned along with the world.
text_cn: 我们即使受罚，只是受主的惩戒，免得我们和这世界一同被定罪。

text_en: So then, my brothers and sisters, when you come together to eat, wait for one another.
text_cn: 所以，我的弟兄们，当你们聚集吃晚餐时，要彼此等待。

text_en: If you are hungry, eat at home, so that when you come together, it will not be for your condemnation. About the other things I will give instructions when I come.
text_cn: 谁若饿了，在家里先吃，免得你们聚集自遭判决。其余的事，等我来了再安排。
